declaration.preface:
At First Quality Knits, a division of Nectar Crafts, we believe that fair compensation is fundamental to human dignity, workforce stability, and sustainable business performance. This Living Wage Policy reflects our commitment to ensuring that all employees receive wages that meet or exceed not only legal minimum requirements but also the basic cost of living in their respective regions.

We recognize that a living wage enables workers and their families to afford essential needs such as food, housing, healthcare, education, and transportation, while allowing for discretionary income and savings. Through this policy, First Quality Knits seeks to promote decent working conditions, reduce income inequality, and support the well-being of our workforce.

This policy applies to all direct employees and extends our expectations to contractors, suppliers, and business partners, promoting responsible wage practices throughout our value chain.

definitions.title: Living Wage Definition & Methodology
definitions.content:
Living Wage Policy reflects our commitment to ensuring that all employees receive wages that meet or exceed not only legal minimum requirements but also the basic cost of living in their respective regions.

We recognize that a living wage enables workers and their families to afford essential needs such as food, housing, healthcare, education, and transportation, while allowing for discretionary income and savings.

First Quality Knits is committed to paying all employees a fair and equitable wage that reflects the regional cost of living and ensures access to essential needs such as food, housing, healthcare, education, and transportation.

Our wage structure is designed to be periodically reviewed and adjusted based on local economic conditions, living cost benchmarks, and inflation trend.

This policy applies to all employees of First Quality Knits, including full-time, part-time, contractual, and third-party workers across all operational sites.

The year 2022 serves as the baseline for all fair wage-related targets at First Quality Knits. This includes commitments to wage equity, living wage alignment, and wage transparency across all employee categories. Progress will be measured against this baseline to ensure continuous improvement and alignment with evolving standards and targets set to be achieved by year 2027.

Wage data is reviewed annually across all roles and locations to ensure alignment with local living cost benchmarks and internal equity.

The review will evaluate the relevance of the policy in light of: Local inflation and living costs; Industry wage benchmarks; Internal wage equity and employee feedback.

Annual Wage Review and Equity: Maintain equitable wage distribution across departments, taking into account performance, gender, role, and background.
Regularly conduct annual wage assessments to reflect changes in local living costs and support employee well-being.
Publish an annual Wage Monitoring Report, detailing wage levels, living wage alignment, and equity performance.
Employee Satisfaction on Fair Wages: Foster a culture where employees believe their compensation is fair and commensurate with their contribution.
Regularly evaluate employee satisfaction on fair wage perception in annual employee surveys by year 2027.
Performance-Based Wage Increases: Apply a clear, performance-linked wage increment policy tied to employee output and skill growth.

targets.target: Continuously ensure 100% of employees receive wages equal to or above the local living wage benchmark.
Maintain 100% compliance in wage equity audits across all departments.
Complete annual wage reviews for 100% of employees by March each year.
Ensure 50% of employees receive performance-based wage increases annually, recognizing individual contribution and growth.

responsibilities.duty: The Human Resources Manager shall be responsible for compiling and maintaining the Living Wage Performance Report in consultation with the Finance Department and Performance Management Team.
To provide accurate financial and wage-related data.
For identifying wage increases linked to skill development and performance.
The final report will be submitted annually to senior management and shared with employee representatives to promote transparency.

policy.monitoring:
First Quality Knits is committed to upholding living wage standards through structured monitoring and transparent reporting. Wage data is reviewed annually across all roles and locations to ensure alignment with local living cost benchmarks and internal equity.

Regular wage audits, employee feedback surveys, and wage gap analyses are conducted to assess compliance and identify areas for improvement. Key findings are shared with senior management and used to update wage structures, ensuring accountability and continuous progress.
policy.reviewMechanism:
The living Wage Policy will be reviewed annually by the HR Manager, in collaboration with the Management. The review will evaluate the relevance of the policy in light of:

Local inflation and living costs

Industry wage benchmarks

Internal wage equity and employee feedback

Updates will be made as necessary to ensure continued alignment with First Quality Knits values and international best practices.
